services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: A fun-filled hour of games, songs, and stories. The perfect time and place for “acting up!” This class uses dramatic play to foster young children’s imagination, creativity, and social development. It goes beyond traditional playtime, offering a unique blend of storytelling, role-playing, and interactive games designed to spark their imagination and build confidence. All the fun with none of the effort! Build the basics of acting through games and activities celebrating your most creative “you.” Get a taste of stardom and explore the process of theatre training through high-energy theatre games, improvisation, and activities. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Step 1- Fill out the “Field Trip & Program Request Form” at the link below. Note that this a request, not a final reservation. Step 2- One of our staff members will contact you to discuss your options. Please allow 7-10 business days for this communication. The cost is $11 per person- all students, teachers, chaperones and bus drivers wishing to watch the performance must have a ticket. There must be a minimum ratio of 1 adult for every 10 students. Please review the age ranges and show dates for each production

services.name: Facilities & Rentals
services.desc: SCCT’s Bell Stage is our 300-seat proscenium stage. This is our most traditional theatre and is home to everything from big musicals to smaller plays. Audience members can expect to see larger-scale productions, but in an environment that is still accessible and where everyone feels close to the action.
